name: Sniper's Eye

start.dialog: Hey there, gorgeous. Wanna test your aim? The Prism formations make for tricky shooting - lots of reflections. Hit 10 targets through the crystal maze and I'll share some premium ammo.
start.objective: Shoot 10 targets through the crystal reflection maze

progress.dialog: Nice shooting! The refraction angle changes based on crystal type. Adjust accordingly!
progress.objective: Continue hitting targets using crystal reflections

complete.dialog: Bullseye every time! You've got natural talent! Here - AP ammo, Pulse ammo, and my special: Shotgun ammo. Use 'em wisely, cowboy.

party_comments.kade: Trick shots through crystals. That's impressive marksmanship.
party_comments.twist: BANG! Did you see that ricochet?!
party_comments.nix7: Ballistic trajectory calculation: complex. Success rate: impressive.

hidden_outcome: If you hit all targets with headshots, Irvine gives you 'Exeter' - his ultimate rifle
